prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a mesmerizing high-resolution studio beauty portrait of an adult woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness without alteration. Her medium-dark straight hair is visibly wet, with strands clinging around her face, shoulders, and back. Both hands are raised with fingers gently spread through her wet hair, pushing it back from forehead and crown. Natural water droplets glisten on forehead, cheekbones, and jawline. Use an intense orange-red light across the camera-left side of her face and an electric blue-green light across the camera-right side and shoulder, creating a sharp color division. Keep direct dark-hazel or brown eye contact, small natural catchlights, a silver stud earring, and a teal-to-emerald blurred background. Shoot as an 85mm f/2 high-fashion studio portrait with sharp eyes, visible pores, natural skin texture, and saturated complementary color separation without beauty-filter smoothing.
